source.author: @ChartsLector
source.note: Rebuilt from his public TradingView scripts and posts. Research view only: none of these systems trades on either desk yet.

ratios.note: stand-in for his Nasdaq growth/value pair

scorecards.name: Opportunity Ranker
scorecards.what: Scores each name on breakout, expansion and risk over 10/20/42/63-day horizons; Opp is the average.
scorecards.build: Exact Opp and horizon weights; the three components are fitted to his published screenshots.

faith.text: Held-out screenshots: Opp error about 3 points, rank correlation about 0.88.

scorecards.caveat: His watchlist is picked today, so its back-history flatters it; small-cap results also carry survivor bias.

scorecards.name: TradingView screeners
scorecards.what: His posted screens: Qullamaggie trend, Hot Stocks, high-volume close, breadth screener.
scorecards.build: Exact filters as posted; float uses a shares-outstanding stand-in.
scorecards.caveat: Small-cap test history carries survivor bias; the refined row is our own variant, not his.

scorecards.name: Breadth View (Pradeep / Zorrilla style)
scorecards.what: Counts of big movers up vs down and a 0-12 Breadth Score.
scorecards.build: Same tables on our daily store (about 1,800 names vs his 4,500).

scorecards.name: Theme / sector leaderboard
scorecards.what: Theme and sector ETFs ranked by 1D/1W/1M/3M performance.

scorecards.name: Relative strength and volume table
scorecards.what: Percent rank of each ETF vs SPY over 5/21/63/126 days, plus relative volume.

scorecards.name: Relative Robustness Rotation
scorecards.what: RRG-style map: RS-Ratio vs RS-Momentum against SPY, four quadrants.
scorecards.build: Pine translation of his script (blended fast/slow, acceleration term).

scorecards.name: Risk appetite ratios
scorecards.what: Six growth/value, junk/treasury and size ratios vs their 20-day average.
scorecards.build: Five of his six pairs exactly; QQQ/QQQE stands in for his Nasdaq growth/value pair.

scorecards.name: Market breadth panel
scorecards.what: Percent of stocks above their 20/50/200-day averages.
scorecards.build: Our daily store; visual only in his posts (no rules).

scorecards.name: Market Action Pulse, VIX Mood Ring, Risk Model
scorecards.what: Market state (GREEN to RED), a 0-100 volatility mood score and a 0-100 risk score.
scorecards.build: Full Pine translation, including each script version from his git history.
scorecards.caveat: The contrarian read has very few independent events; treat it as a lead, not a proven edge.

scorecards.name: Per-ticker Pine tools
scorecards.what: 1M RS, candle stage, ATR matrix, gaps, calibrated RSI, EM-GMR, low-of-day entry.

scorecards.name: Volatility / dispersion / correlation
scorecards.what: Weekly dispersion and correlation read for fragility.
scorecards.build: Generic stand-in: his formulas are not public.

scorecards.name: SPY / QQQ gamma exposure
scorecards.what: Dealer gamma levels with a stochastic model.
scorecards.build: Not rebuildable: no formula and no options feed in his posts.

scorecards.name: His trading rules stack
scorecards.what: Trend screen + not extended + low-of-day entry + market filter, then his moving-average exit.
scorecards.build: Rules as written in his posts.

scorecards.name: His Python pipeline
scorecards.what: Data, features, ranker and report stages.
scorecards.build: Layout only; the rebuild above maps each stage to a module.
